title: Triples with Bitwise AND Equal To Zero
description: Count triples (i, j, k) such that nums[i] & nums[j] & nums[k] == 0.
pseudocode:
1. count = map frequency of all (nums[i] & nums[j])
2. result = 0
3. for each num in nums:
4.   for each val, freq in count:
5.     if (val & num) == 0: result += freq

steps.note: Iterate num=2. Check pairs (val & 2 == 0). Valid pairs: (0, 0) -> freq 2. Result = 2
Iterate num=1. Check pairs (val & 1 == 0). Valid pairs: (2, 2, 2, 2) -> freq 4. Result = 6
Iterate num=3. Check pairs (val & 3 == 0). Valid pairs: (0, 0) -> freq 2. Result = 8
Final count after evaluating all combinations is 12.
